# equivalence: do two formalizations say the same thing?

A claim can be mistranscribed into Lean. A second formalization written separately, plus a proof that the two
statements are equivalent (that does not use either theorem's proof), makes a mistranscription in either less
likely. Review still decides whether either says what the paper says.
